'''Teek''' was a [[Zygerrian/Legends|Zygerrian]] [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] trader who served aboard captain [[Onyx (individual)|Onyx's]] ship during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]]. He was captured with the rest of the crew by [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knights]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi]] and [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Anakin Skywalker]].
